shard.title: Subject: Telephone In Household
shard.basis: the publisher's subject list, from gssrdoc in the current release (7224r3a)

questions.text:
Thank you very much for your time and help. Do you have a telephone? May I have your name and (one of your) telephone number(s) just in case I have left something out in this interview? 
ENTER NAME AND PHONE NUMBER. IF NO PHONE OR REFUSED, CIRCLE APPROPRIATE CODE NUMBER.

values.origin_note: Stored as an ordinary value, but the label suggests a missing code.
